empirical_result.statement: At p=12043, 40 eligible Hecke rows from translated sources with different absolute traces add 40 total rational rank but zero induced rank on the original 117 torsion-orbit columns after 128 new columns are eliminated.

structural_theorem.conclusion: The old components of combinations of old rows and new rows whose new component vanishes equal S exactly.
structural_theorem.hypotheses: Additive groups O,N,W; old-only set S subset O; additive maps A:W to O and B:W to N; B injective.
structural_theorem.instance_bridge: The 40 private new columns form an identity 40 by 40 submatrix and independently certify injectivity of the new projection B over Q; Python checks this exact instance, while the matrix-to-Lean construction remains open.
